scope: Known documentary development cases; no held-out or scientific evaluation
question: Can the named local generators or actual reranker improve the known field task, and can Hermes complete the same bounded documentary task?
primary: Task correctly completed with exact identity, state and trial, explicit missing reason/sample, no invented changes or other-identity numbers
ranking: Same authorized corrected candidate pool, same card budget, compare required-field retention before and after yes/no logit scoring
hermes: Local-only documentary comparison with same known evidence and local model; tools disabled, separate home, no external inference
resource_rule: One inference model at a time; bounded requests; resource failures are outcomes, not successful runs
promotion: No default component promotion from one development episode. Deterministic verified field lookup remains available.
